title: PixSearch: Region-Grounded Retrieval for Knowledgeable Large Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.19060v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) augments visual question answering (VQA) with external knowledge, but many systems rely on modular pipelines that separate visual grounding, query construction, and answer generation. This separation can propagate errors from intermediate detections, masks, or captions into retrieval while adding latency and limiting coordination with ongoing reasoning. These limitations are especially consequential for egocentric images, where questions often concern small, off-center, or long-tail entities that global retrieval can overlook. We propose PixSearch, an end-to-end segmenting Large Multimodal Model (LMM) that unifies region-level visual grounding with retrieval-augmented reasoning. translated_title: PixSearch：面向知识增强大型多模态模型的区域级定位检索
translated_abstract: 多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）通过引入外部知识来增强视觉问答（VQA），但许多系统依赖于模块化流水线，将视觉定位、查询构建和答案生成相互分离。这种分离会使中间检测、掩码或字幕中的错误传播到检索环节，同时增加延迟并限制了与持续推理过程的协同。这些局限性对于第一人称视角图像的影响尤为显著，因为此类问题往往涉及体积小、偏离画面中心或属于长尾分布的实体，而全局检索容易将其忽略。我们提出了 PixSearch，一个端到端的分割式大型多模态模型（LMM），它将区域级视觉定位与检索增强推理统一起来。在自回归生成过程中，PixSearch 学习何时进行检索、如何在文本、全图和区域级检索之间路由查询，以及如何裁剪目标实体作为视觉查询使用……
tldr: PixSearch 是一个端到端的分割式大型多模态模型，将区域级视觉定位与检索增强推理统一起来，可自主学习检索时机、在文本/全图/区域级检索之间路由查询并裁剪目标实体作为视觉查询，从而避免传统模块化流水线的误差传播、延迟及全局检索忽略小实体的问题。
en_tdlr: PixSearch is an end-to-end segmenting Large Multimodal Model that unifies region-level visual grounding with retrieval-augmented reasoning, autonomously learning when to retrieve, how to route queries across text, whole-image, and region-level retrieval, and how to crop target entities as visual queries, thereby overcoming error propagation, latency, and oversight of small or long-tail entities inherent in modular pipelines.
